svg.title: Agentroid: give your AI agent a real Android phone
svg.desc: A real Xiaomi POCO X6 Pro home screen, shown on a phone standing on a desk (the screen is a real screenshot; the phone body and desk are a generated picture). Beside it, an example: you ask the AI to open Claude on the phone; through Agentroid it looks at the screen, taps the Claude app, then asks only for what changed. One look costs up to 50 times fewer tokens than Android's raw screen description: 229 tokens for Agentroid's short answer and 1,241 for its full list (9 times fewer), against 11,565, measured on one real home screen with Claude Opus 5.5.
